items.intro_words: Okay, now we are all set. Evelyn, can we have a roll call, please?
Trustee Márquez? Here. Trustee Weekly? Present. Trustee MacAvoy?
Item 4.2, report out on closed session from February 7th, 2024.
3.1, conference with real property negotiators. No action was taken.
Welcome everybody to February sixth board meeting, 2024.
Moving on to 6.1, Changes to the Agenda. Thank you.
Okay, we are on oral communication. We have a card from Brian Kegel and Aaron Washburn.
Let's see, we are on bond consent items. The motion to approve.
We have no bond program action items, so we'll move on to 11.1, Information on Financial Audit Report for RCSD.

Okay, 11.2, Communications Update, RCSD Logo Redesign Project. So we have Mr. Quintana here this evening that's going to give you an update on the logo redesign and also the different designs that were done at the school sites.
Now we'll retire the little schoolhouse and move forward. And a lot of swag to buy now, right?
We are moving on to 11.3, Report on RCSD THRIVE Manual as part of the Homeless Initiative Practice.
Um, let's see, 12 consent items. I'll move to approve.
Item 14.1, report from board members and superintendent. Who would like to start?
Item 15.1, information on San Mateo County Investment Fund. Are there any questions?
Um, 17.1, possible other business, suggested items for the future agenda.
Okay, uh, 18.1, Changes to the Board Meeting Calendar.
Okay, that brings us to the end of our agenda. I move we adjourn.
